Product.title: Product
Product.description: A writing instrument or general product listed in Arefin Mart storefront.

orderCount.description: Total units of this product ordered across customer orders.

featuredUntilMs.description: Optional Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds until which this product remains displayed in Featured Products on the homepage.

featuredOrder.description: Optional display serial number (1, 2, 3, 4...) controlling position order inside Featured Products on the homepage.

stockCount.description: Auto-calculated total available quantity across all in-stock colour variants.

colors.description: List of body colour variants with id, name, hex, inStock, per-colour stockCount, optional image URL, and inkColors combo array.

specs.description: Technical pen specifications including tipSize, inkType, inkColor, inkColorHex, multi-select inkColors array, bodyMaterial, weight, and origin.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: An authenticated customer Cash on Delivery order record visible strictly to the placing user (matching uid or verified sign-in email) and verified admins in the Admin Panel.

orderItems.description: Structured ordered items (productId, productName, colorId, colorName, optional inkColorId/inkColorName, quantity) used for atomic stock deduction and order-deletion restoration.

StoreMeta.title: StoreMeta
StoreMeta.description: Metadata document for catalog seeding and global serial order counter starting at #1.

ProductRating.title: ProductRating
ProductRating.description: Authenticated customer star rating (1-5) and optional public review comment for a storefront product, storing no PII.

ChatWidgetConfig.title: ChatWidgetConfig
ChatWidgetConfig.description: Public storefront floating WhatsApp and multi-app messaging launcher configuration managed by admins.

buttonSize.description: Optional diameter in pixels (40 to 96) for the floating circle chat button.

channels.description: Optional additional messaging apps (WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, imo, Viber, WeChat, LINE, Discord, Signal, Instagram, Facebook, Phone, Email, Custom Link) up to 10 entries, each supporting custom label, handle, URL, colour (hex or liquid-glass), iconStyle, customIconUrl, and prefillMessage.

/products/{productId}.description: Live storefront product catalogue readable by all visitors and managed by admins.

/productRatings/{ratingId}.description: Publicly readable customer star ratings & optional reviews; verified signed-in customers may create, update, or delete only their own composite-keyed rating ({productId}__{uid}).

/orders/{orderId}.description: Customer orders isolated strictly to the placing user (userId == auth.uid or userEmail == auth.token.email) and verified admins.

/meta/chatWidget.description: Publicly readable floating WhatsApp & messaging launcher settings customizable exclusively by verified admins.

/meta/{metaId}.description: Storefront metadata including global serial order counter (#1, #2, #3...) and initial seed flag.
